children: Establishment Labs’ third-quarter revenue rose 33.9% year over year, while its net loss narrowed. Growth was led by higher U.S. sales, with gains outside the U.S. also contributing; gross margin declined amid restructuring-related inventory charges and a higher mix of lower-margin distributor sales.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Basic and diluted net loss per share”.
: Increased $14.2 million year over year in the quarter.
: Sales outside the U.S. increased $4.1 million year over year.
: Fell to 69.1% from 70.1%, primarily due to restructuring-related inventory charges and a higher mix of lower-margin distributor sales.
: Revenue growth from the portfolio partially offset the quarter’s gross-margin pressures.
